neighbours.label: privative/negative prefixes in hyphenated compounds: ' non-' (x14 in the top 32), ' anti-' (x6), ' post-' (x2) — non-employees, non-Muslim, anti-virus, post-war; the + pole peaks on the prefix piece itself
fire: The insurance also covers non-drivers in the household.
The club welcomes non-members at its open evenings.
The anti-spam filter caught the message.
The post-election debate lasted three hours.
They offer non-alcoholic beer at the bar.
The anti-theft device locked the bike.
quiet: The insurance also covers drivers in the household.
The club welcomes members at its open evenings.
The spam filter caught the message.
The election debate lasted three hours.
They offer alcoholic beer at the bar.
The theft device locked the bike.

notes: Card: ' non' x14, ' anti' x6, ' post' x2, ' %' x3 in the top 32. Probes: sentences with non-/anti-/post- compounds fire 0.04-0.32 peaking on the prefix piece; the same topics without the prefix score <= 0.005.
